<!-- 1. Include the toaster element in your page (optional: auto-injected if omitted) -->
<ui-toaster position="bottom-right"></ui-toaster>

<!-- 2. Trigger toasts from any framework or script -->
<script type="module">
  import { toast } from 'nnui-kit';

  // Default Toast
  toast('Your event has been scheduled.');

  // Success Toast with description
  toast.success('Changes saved', {
    description: 'All workspace preferences updated.',
  });

  // Error Toast
  toast.error('Could not complete request', {
    description: 'Please check your connection and retry.',
  });

  // Toast with interactive Action button
  toast('File archived', {
    description: 'Moved to trash folder.',
    action: {
      label: 'Undo',
      onClick: () => toast.success('Action undone!'),
    },
  });
</script>
toast.svelteCode:
<script>
  import { toast } from 'nnui-kit';

  function showToast() {
    toast.success('Action completed successfully!', {
      description: 'Your changes have been saved to the cloud.',
      action: {
        label: 'Undo',
        onClick: () => console.log('Undo triggered'),
      },
    });
  }
</script>

<ui-toaster position="bottom-right"></ui-toaster>

<button data-ui="button" onclick={showToast}>
  Show Toast Notification
</button>
